commands.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; echo source_head=$(git rev-parse origin/main); SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo serial=$SERIAL; echo '--- current user ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am get-current-user || true; echo '--- users ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm list users || adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd user list || true; echo '--- package dump io.blueeye ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package io.blueeye 2>&1 | sed -n '1,240p' || true; echo '--- package paths by likely users ---'; for u in 0 10 11 12 95 96 97 98 99 150 151; do printf 'user_%s=' "$u"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user "$u" io.blueeye 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; echo '--- package enabled state by likely users ---'; for u in 0 10 11 12 95 96 97 98 99 150 151; do printf 'user_%s=' "$u"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd package list packages --user "$u" io.blueeye 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
